tldr: The Moon through the 11th house sensitizes friends, groups, community, networks, and future plans.
body:
When the Moon moves through your 11th house, it makes you more sensitive to friends, groups, audience, networks, community, hopes, and where you belong. You may notice who you are connected to, which groups still feel alive, and what kind of future you want to be part of.

A need, mood, habit, or private reaction may become harder to ignore. It can help you read what you need before the feeling gets louder.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for seeing where belonging supports you and where it has become performative.

The caution: Watch for treating a temporary mood as the whole truth. The risk is staying attached to a group, plan, or audience that no longer fits.

The Moon moves through this house for a few days. Treat the feeling as information. Give it a grounded place to land before you react from it.
